description: Fill a PDF form's fields client and server side from freedailypro — sets text/checkbox/dropdown/radio field values and returns the filled PDF, optionally flattened so it can no longer be edited

checked.description: Field name -> checked state, for checkbox fields

flatten.description: If true, bakes the values in and removes the ability to edit them further

values.description: Field name -> text value, for text/dropdown/radio fields

name: pdf_fill_form
